Generic recall that emergency measures belong in a preventive regulation is too obvious and overlaps the incident-decision domain without a sufficiently specific facility-law boundary.
Generic safety-record inclusion is shallow recall with low discrimination and no meaningful boundary detail.
The prescribed tool set is specific to alkylaluminum-related hazards outside Class 4 and has low marginal value for an Otsu4 bank.

The 20 kPa inert-gas boundary is specific to alkylaluminum storage and has low Otsu4 relevance despite being source-correct.
Closed-hours nonstaff exclusion is semantically too close to canonical B3 access-control question OTSU4-Q-000032; context narrowing does not justify another permanent question.
The 0.2 MPa withdrawal inert-gas rule is specific to alkylaluminum outside Class 4 and has low Otsu4 relevance.
